_description: Sample submission template. Copy this file and fill in the fields, then run submission_pickup.py to route to Slimeko.
_usage: Place .json files in data/submissions/ with any filename. Run: python3 scripts/submission_pickup.py --execute

_fields.gameName: Required. Game name as entered by submitter.
_fields.steamId: Optional. Steam App ID if provided.
_fields.centrality: a, b, c, d, or empty (necromancy only)
_fields.vampirism: outright, implied, channeled, absent, or empty (blood only)
_fields.hemomancy: a, b, c, d, absent, or empty (blood only)
